_comment: Real customer reviews go here. Need at least 6-8 before launch: 3 feature on the homepage, 6 on /reviews/, and any whose "city" matches a service-area page slug (see service-areas/*/index.html for slugs, e.g. "Plano", "Fort Worth") will replace that city page's placeholder testimonial. Do not fabricate — leave this array short rather than inventing entries. Run `python _gen/apply_business_config.py` after adding reviews to bake them in; pages with no matching real review keep their [[PLACEHOLDER]] marker.

_schema_example.name: Real first name + last initial, e.g. "Sarah M."
_schema_example.city: Must match a service-area page name exactly for city-page injection, e.g. "Plano"
_schema_example.text: The real review text, verbatim or lightly trimmed for length
